label: Thomas Aquinas, Compendium theologiae I…: GOD_4 is one: whatever is GOD_4 is the same
locator: I cap.15, [69988], three arguments for impossibility of several Gods; context capp.12–14
interpretation: The conclusion is at-most-one proper divine being, not an existential proof and not a denial of distinct divine persons. The final argument constrains multiplicability of forms by differentiae or receiving subjects, then applies the previously claimed no-differentiae/subsistent-esse conditions to God. The source supplies an argument schema for uniqueness; this claim does not show that arbitrary necessary uncaused candidates satisfy its stronger conditions or that its division of individuation is independently established.
